46	class AccScalePipe[T <: Data, U <: Data](t: T, rDataType: Vec[Vec[T]], scale_func: (T, U) => T, scale_t: U,
47	                                         latency: Int, has_nonlinear_activations: Boolean, has_normalizations: Boolean)
48	                                        (implicit ev: Arithmetic[T]) extends Module {
49	  val u = scale_t
50	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
51	    val in = Input(Valid(new AccScaleDataWithIndex(t, u)(ev)))
52	    val out = Output(Valid(new AccScaleDataWithIndex(t, u)(ev)))
53	  })
54	  import ev._
55	  val out = WireInit(io.in)
56	
57	  val e = io.in.bits.data
58	
59	  val act = io.in.bits.act
60	  // make sure no normalizations gets passed in if no functional units present
61	  assert(has_normalizations.B || (!io.in.fire) ||
62	    (act =/= Activation.LAYERNORM && act =/= Activation.SOFTMAX && act =/= Activation.IGELU))
63	
64	  val e_act: T = MuxCase(e, if (has_normalizations) Seq(
65	    (has_nonlinear_activations.B && act === Activation.RELU) -> e.relu,
66	    (has_nonlinear_activations.B && has_normalizations.B && act === Activation.LAYERNORM) ->
67	      (e - io.in.bits.mean),
68	    (has_nonlinear_activations.B && has_normalizations.B && act === Activation.IGELU) ->
69	      AccumulatorScale.igelu(e, io.in.bits.igelu_qb, io.in.bits.igelu_qc),
70	    (has_nonlinear_activations.B && has_normalizations.B && act === Activation.SOFTMAX) ->
71	      AccumulatorScale.iexp(e - io.in.bits.max, io.in.bits.iexp_qln2, io.in.bits.iexp_qln2_inv, io.in.bits.igelu_qb, io.in.bits.igelu_qc),
72	  ) else Seq(
73	    (has_nonlinear_activations.B && act === Activation.RELU) -> e.relu
74	  ))
75	
76	  val e_scaled: T = scale_func(e_act, if (has_normalizations) MuxCase(io.in.bits.scale, Seq(
77	    (has_nonlinear_activations.B && has_normalizations.B && act === Activation.LAYERNORM) ->
78	      io.in.bits.inv_stddev,
79	    (has_nonlinear_activations.B && has_normalizations.B && act === Activation.SOFTMAX) ->
80	      io.in.bits.inv_sum_exp.asTypeOf(scale_t)
81	  )).asTypeOf(scale_t) else io.in.bits.scale.asTypeOf(scale_t))
82	
83	  val e_clipped = e_scaled.clippedToWidthOf(rDataType.head.head)
84	
85	  out.bits.data := e_clipped
86	  io.out := Pipe(out, latency)
87	}

224	        def flip_n_zeros (s: List[Char], n: Int): List[Char] = {
225	          if (s.nonEmpty) {
226	            if ((s.head == '0') && (n > 0))
227	              '1' :: flip_n_zeros(s.tail, n - 1)
228	            else
229	              s.head :: flip_n_zeros(s.tail, n)
230	          } else {
231	            assert(n == 0, "cannot flip " + n + " zeros in an empty string")
232	            List.empty
233	          }
234	        }
235	        val flippedString = flip_n_zeros(
236	          binaryString, Math.round(ratio_of_norm_units * nEntries) - num_norm)
237	        val flipped = Integer.parseInt(flippedString.mkString(""), 2)
238	        static_assignment_policy(i.U) := flipped.U
239	        println("input pattern " + binaryString.mkString("") + ": " + flipped.toBinaryString)
240	      }
241	    }
242	
243	    //    val inputs = Seq.fill(width*nEntries) { Wire(Decoupled(new AccScaleDataWithIndex(t, scale_t)(ev))) }
244	    val current_policy = Wire(UInt(nEntries.W))
245	    val norm_mask_int = Wire(UInt(nEntries.W))
246	    norm_mask_int := VecInit(norm_mask).asUInt
247	    dontTouch(norm_mask_int)
248	    current_policy := static_assignment_policy(norm_mask_int)
249	
250	
251	    for (i <- 0 until nEntries) {
252	      for (w <- 0 until width) {
253	        val input = inputs_norm(i*width+w)
254	
255	        val acc_read_resp = regs(i).bits.acc_read_resp
256	
257	        input.valid       := regs(i).valid && !fired_masks(i)(w) && /*norm_mask(i)*/ current_policy(i)
258	        input.bits.data   := acc_read_resp.data(w / acc_read_data(0).size)(w % acc_read_data(0).size)
259	        input.bits.full_data := acc_read_resp.data(w / acc_read_data(0).size)(w % acc_read_data(0).size)
260	        input.bits.scale  := acc_read_resp.scale
261	        input.bits.act    := acc_read_resp.act
262	        input.bits.igelu_qb := acc_read_resp.igelu_qb
263	        input.bits.igelu_qc := acc_read_resp.igelu_qc
264	        input.bits.iexp_qln2 := acc_read_resp.iexp_qln2
265	        input.bits.iexp_qln2_inv := acc_read_resp.iexp_qln2_inv
266	        input.bits.mean := regs(i).bits.mean
267	        input.bits.max := regs(i).bits.max
268	        input.bits.inv_stddev := regs(i).bits.inv_stddev
269	        input.bits.inv_sum_exp := regs(i).bits.inv_sum_exp
270	        input.bits.id := i.U
271	        input.bits.index := w.U
272	        when (input.fire) {
273	          fired_masks(i)(w) := true.B
274	        }
275	      }
276	    }
277	
278	    for (i <- 0 until nEntries) {
279	      for (w <- 0 until width) {
280	        val input = inputs_non_norm(i*width+w)
281	
282	        val acc_read_resp = regs(i).bits.acc_read_resp
283	
284	        input.valid       := regs(i).valid && !fired_masks(i)(w) && (!current_policy(i))
285	        input.bits.data   := acc_read_resp.data(w / acc_read_data(0).size)(w % acc_read_data(0).size)
286	        input.bits.full_data := acc_read_resp.data(w / acc_read_data(0).size)(w % acc_read_data(0).size)
287	        input.bits.scale  := acc_read_resp.scale
288	        input.bits.act    := acc_read_resp.act
289	        input.bits.igelu_qb := DontCare
290	        input.bits.igelu_qc := DontCare
291	        input.bits.iexp_qln2 := DontCare
292	        input.bits.iexp_qln2_inv := DontCare
293	        input.bits.mean := DontCare
294	        input.bits.max := DontCare
295	        input.bits.inv_stddev := DontCare
296	        input.bits.inv_sum_exp := DontCare
297	        input.bits.id := i.U
298	        input.bits.index := w.U
299	        if (num_scale_units == num_units_with_norm) {
300	          input.ready := false.B
301	        }
302	        when (input.fire) {
303	          fired_masks(i)(w) := true.B
304	        }
305	      }
306	    }
307	
308	    for (i <- 0 until num_scale_units) {
309	      val norm_supported = (i < num_units_with_norm) && has_normalizations
310	
311	      val arbIn =
312	        if (norm_supported)
313	          // for norm units, prioritize norm operations
314	          inputs_norm.zipWithIndex.filter({ case (_, w) => w % num_units_with_norm == i }).map(_._1)
315	        else
316	          inputs_non_norm.zipWithIndex.filter({ case (_, w) => w % (num_scale_units - num_units_with_norm) == (i - num_units_with_norm) }).map(_._1)
317	
318	      val arb = Module(new RRArbiter(new AccScaleDataWithIndex(t, scale_t)(ev), arbIn.length))
319	      arb.io.in <> arbIn
320	      arb.io.out.ready := true.B
321	      val arbOut = Reg(Valid(new AccScaleDataWithIndex(t, scale_t)(ev)))
322	      arbOut.valid := arb.io.out.valid
323	      arbOut.bits  := arb.io.out.bits
324	      when (reset.asBool) {
325	        arbOut.valid := false.B
326	      }
327	      val pipe = Module(new AccScalePipe(t, rDataType, scale_func, scale_t, latency,
328	            has_nonlinear_activations, norm_supported))
329	
330	      pipe.io.in := arbOut
331	      val pipe_out = pipe.io.out
332	
333	      for (j <- 0 until nEntries) {
334	        for (w <- 0 until width) {
335	          val id0 = w % acc_read_data(0).size
336	          val id1 = w / acc_read_data(0).size
337	            if ((j*width+w) % num_units_with_norm == i) {
338	              when (pipe_out.fire && pipe_out.bits.id === j.U && pipe_out.bits.index === w.U) {
339	                out_regs(j).data     (id1)(id0) := pipe_out.bits.data
340	                out_regs(j).full_data(id1)(id0) := pipe_out.bits.full_data
341	                completed_masks(j)(w) := true.B
342	              }
343	            }
344	            if (num_scale_units > num_units_with_norm) {
345	              if ((j*width+w) % (num_scale_units - num_units_with_norm) == (i - num_units_with_norm)) {
346	                val id0 = w % acc_read_data(0).size
347	                val id1 = w / acc_read_data(0).size
348	                when (pipe_out.fire && pipe_out.bits.id === j.U && pipe_out.bits.index === w.U) {
349	                  out_regs(j).data     (id1)(id0) := pipe_out.bits.data
350	                  out_regs(j).full_data(id1)(id0) := pipe_out.bits.full_data
351	                  completed_masks(j)(w) := true.B
352	                }
353	              }
354	            }
355	        }
356	      }
357	    }
358	    when (reset.asBool) {
359	      regs.foreach(_.valid := false.B)
360	    }
361	  }
362	
363	  io.out <> out
364	
365	  if (read_small_data)
366	    io.out.bits.data := out.bits.data
367	  else
368	    io.out.bits.data := DontCare
369	
370	  if (read_full_data)
371	    io.out.bits.full_data := out.bits.full_data
372	  else
373	    io.out.bits.full_data := DontCare
374	}

376	object AccumulatorScale {
377	  def igelu[T <: Data](q: T, qb: T, qc: T)(implicit ev: Arithmetic[T]): T = {
378	    import ev._
379	
380	    val zero = q.zero
381	    val one = q.identity
382	    def neg(x: T) = zero-x
383	
384	    val q_sign = Mux(q.zero > q, neg(one), one)
385	    val q_abs = Mux(q.zero > q, neg(q), q)
386	    val q_clipped = Mux(q_abs > neg(qb), neg(qb), q_abs)
387	    val q_poly = qc.mac(q_clipped + qb, q_clipped + qb).withWidthOf(q)
388	    val q_erf = (q_sign * q_poly).withWidthOf(q)
389	    (q * (q_erf + qc)).withWidthOf(q)
390	  }
391	
392	  def iexp[T <: Data](q: T, qln2: T, qln2_inv: T, qb: T, qc: T)(implicit ev: Arithmetic[T]): T = {
393	    /*
394	    import ev._
395	
396	    val zero = q.zero
397	    def neg(x: T) = zero-x
398	
399	    // qln2_inv needs scale to be 1 / (2 ** 16) / S
400	    // qln2_inv / S / (2 ** 16) = 1 / ln2
401	    // q * qln2_inv = x / S / ln2 * S * (2 ** 16) = x / ln2 * (2 ** 16)
402	    val neg_q_iexp = neg(q)
403	    val z_iexp = (neg_q_iexp * qln2_inv).asUInt.do_>>(16).asTypeOf(q) // q is non-positive
404	    val z_iexp_saturated = Wire(z_iexp.cloneType)
405	    z_iexp_saturated := Mux((5 until 16).map(z_iexp.asUInt(_)).reduce(_ | _), 32.S.asTypeOf(z_iexp), z_iexp)
406	    val qp_iexp = q.mac(z_iexp, qln2).withWidthOf(q)
407	    val q_poly_iexp = qc.mac(qp_iexp + qb, qp_iexp + qb).withWidthOf(q)
408	    // we dont want a rounding shift
409	    //  TODO: z overflow
410	    (q_poly_iexp.asUInt.do_>>(z_iexp_saturated.asUInt)).asTypeOf(q) */
411	    import ev._
412	
413	    val zero = q.zero
414	    val one = q.identity
415	    def neg(x: T) = zero-x
416	
417	    val q_sign = Mux(q.zero > q, neg(one), one)
418	    val q_abs = Mux(q.zero > q, neg(q), q)
419	    val q_clipped = Mux(q_abs > neg(qb), neg(qb), q_abs)
420	    val q_poly = qc.mac(q_clipped + qb, q_clipped + qb).withWidthOf(q)
421	    val q_erf = (q_sign * q_poly).withWidthOf(q)
422	    (q * (q_erf + qc)).withWidthOf(q)
423	  }}

100	class ScratchpadBank(n: Int, w: Int, aligned_to: Int, single_ported: Boolean, use_shared_ext_mem: Boolean, is_dummy: Boolean) extends Module {
101	  // This is essentially a pipelined SRAM with the ability to stall pipeline stages
102	
103	  require(w % aligned_to == 0 || w < aligned_to)
104	  val mask_len = (w / (aligned_to * 8)) max 1 // How many mask bits are there?
105	  val mask_elem = UInt((w min (aligned_to * 8)).W) // What datatype does each mask bit correspond to?
106	
107	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
108	    val read = Flipped(new ScratchpadReadIO(n, w))
109	    val write = Flipped(new ScratchpadWriteIO(n, w, mask_len))
110	    val ext_mem = if (use_shared_ext_mem) Some(new ExtMemIO) else None
111	  })
112	
113	  val ren = io.read.req.fire
114	  val fromDMA = io.read.req.bits.fromDMA
115	
116	  // Make a queue which buffers the result of an SRAM read if it can't immediately be consumed
117	  val q = Module(new Queue(new ScratchpadReadResp(w), 1, true, true))
118	  val q_will_be_empty = (q.io.count +& q.io.enq.fire) - q.io.deq.fire === 0.U
119	  // When the scratchpad is single-ported, the writes take precedence
120	  val singleport_busy_with_write = single_ported.B && io.write.fire
121	
122	  if (is_dummy) {
123	    q.io.enq.valid := RegNext(ren)
124	    q.io.enq.bits.data := 0.U
125	    q.io.enq.bits.fromDMA := RegNext(fromDMA)
126	    io.read.req.ready := q_will_be_empty && !singleport_busy_with_write
127	  } else if (use_shared_ext_mem) { // use ready-valid interface
128	    val ext_mem = io.ext_mem.get
129	
130	    /* READ */
131	    ext_mem.read_req.valid := q_will_be_empty && io.read.req.valid
132	    ext_mem.read_req.bits := io.read.req.bits.addr
133	    io.read.req.ready := q_will_be_empty && ext_mem.read_req.ready
134	
135	    // TODO (richard): the number of entries here should be configurable
136	    val dma_q = Module(new Queue(Bool(), 4, false, true))
137	    dma_q.io.enq.valid := ren
138	    dma_q.io.enq.bits := fromDMA
139	    dma_q.io.deq.ready := q.io.enq.fire
140	    assert(dma_q.io.enq.fire === ren, "DMA queue does not have enough entries") // TODO (richard): do backpressure
141	    assert(dma_q.io.deq.fire === q.io.enq.fire, "fromDMA should be dequeued only when read resp comes back")
142	
143	    q.io.enq.valid := ext_mem.read_resp.valid
144	    q.io.enq.bits.data := ext_mem.read_resp.bits
145	    q.io.enq.bits.fromDMA := dma_q.io.deq.bits
146	    ext_mem.read_resp.ready := q.io.enq.ready
147	
148	    /* WRITE */
149	    val wq = Module(new Queue(ext_mem.write_req.bits.cloneType, 4, pipe=true, flow=true))
150	    ext_mem.write_req <> wq.io.deq
151	
152	    wq.io.enq.valid := io.write.valid
153	    io.write.ready := wq.io.enq.ready
154	    wq.io.enq.bits.addr := io.write.addr
155	    wq.io.enq.bits.data := io.write.data
156	    if (aligned_to >= w) {
157	      wq.io.enq.bits.mask := VecInit((~(0.U(mask_len.W))).asBools).asUInt
158	    } else {
159	      wq.io.enq.bits.mask := io.write.mask.asUInt
160	    }
161	    // assert(wq.io.enq.ready || (!io.write.en), "TODO (richard): fix this if triggered")
162	  } else { // use valid only interface
163	    val mem = SyncReadMem(n, Vec(mask_len, mask_elem))
164	
165	    val raddr = io.read.req.bits.addr
166	    val rdata = if (single_ported) {
167	      assert(!(ren && io.write.fire))
168	      mem.read(raddr, ren && !io.write.fire).asUInt
169	    } else {
170	      mem.read(raddr, ren).asUInt
171	    }
172	    q.io.enq.valid := RegNext(ren)
173	    q.io.enq.bits.data := rdata
174	    q.io.enq.bits.fromDMA := RegNext(fromDMA)
175	
176	    io.read.req.ready := q_will_be_empty && !singleport_busy_with_write
177	
178	    io.write.ready := true.B
179	    when(io.write.fire) {
180	      if (aligned_to >= w)
181	        mem.write(io.write.addr, io.write.data.asTypeOf(Vec(mask_len, mask_elem)), VecInit((~(0.U(mask_len.W))).asBools))
182	      else
183	        mem.write(io.write.addr, io.write.data.asTypeOf(Vec(mask_len, mask_elem)), io.write.mask)
184	    }
185	  }
186	
187	  io.read.resp <> q.io.deq
188	}

606	          zero_writer_pixel_repeater.io.resp.ready := true.B // TODO we combinationally couple valid and ready signals
607	        }.otherwise {
608	          bio.write.addr := DontCare
609	          bio.write.data := DontCare
610	          bio.write.mask := DontCare
611	        }
612	      }
613	      banks
614	    }
615	
616	    val acc_row_t = Vec(meshColumns, Vec(tileColumns, accType))
617	    val spad_row_t = Vec(meshColumns, Vec(tileColumns, inputType))
618	
619	    val (acc_norm_unit_in, acc_norm_unit_out) = Normalizer(
620	      is_passthru = !config.has_normalizations,
621	      max_len = block_cols,
622	      num_reduce_lanes = -1,
623	      num_stats = 2,
624	      latency = 4,
625	      fullDataType = acc_row_t,
626	      scale_t = acc_scale_t,
627	    )
628	
629	    acc_norm_unit_in.valid := false.B
630	    acc_norm_unit_in.bits.len := write_norm_q.io.deq.bits.len
631	    acc_norm_unit_in.bits.stats_id := write_norm_q.io.deq.bits.acc_norm_stats_id
632	    acc_norm_unit_in.bits.cmd := write_norm_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.norm_cmd
633	    acc_norm_unit_in.bits.acc_read_resp := DontCare
634	
635	    val acc_scale_unit = Module(new AccumulatorScale(
636	      acc_row_t,
637	      spad_row_t,
638	      acc_scale_t.asInstanceOf[V],
639	      acc_read_small_width,
640	      acc_read_full_width,
641	      acc_scale_func,
642	      acc_scale_num_units,
643	      acc_scale_latency,
644	      has_nonlinear_activations,
645	      has_normalizations,
646	    ))
647	
648	    val acc_waiting_to_be_scaled = write_scale_q.io.deq.valid &&
649	      !write_scale_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.is_garbage() &&
650	      write_scale_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.is_acc_addr &&
651	      write_issue_q.io.enq.ready
652	
653	    acc_norm_unit_out.ready := acc_scale_unit.io.in.ready && acc_waiting_to_be_scaled
654	    acc_scale_unit.io.in.valid := acc_norm_unit_out.valid && acc_waiting_to_be_scaled
655	    acc_scale_unit.io.in.bits  := acc_norm_unit_out.bits
656	
657	    when (acc_scale_unit.io.in.fire) {
658	      write_issue_q.io.enq <> write_scale_q.io.deq
659	    }
660	
661	    acc_scale_unit.io.out.ready := false.B
662	
663	    val dma_resp_ready =
664	      (writer.module.io.req.ready && spad_writer.map(_.module.io.req.ready).getOrElse(true.B)) &&
665	        write_issue_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.is_acc_addr &&
666	        !write_issue_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.is_garbage()
667	
668	    when (acc_scale_unit.io.out.bits.fromDMA && dma_resp_ready) {
669	      // Send the acc-scale result into the DMA
670	      acc_scale_unit.io.out.ready := true.B
671	      writeData.valid := acc_scale_unit.io.out.valid
672	      writeData.bits  := acc_scale_unit.io.out.bits.data.asUInt
673	      fullAccWriteData := acc_scale_unit.io.out.bits.full_data.asUInt
674	    }
675	    for (i <- 0 until acc_banks) {
676	      // Send the acc-sccale result to the ExController
677	      io.acc.read_resp(i).valid := false.B
678	      io.acc.read_resp(i).bits  := acc_scale_unit.io.out.bits
679	      when (!acc_scale_unit.io.out.bits.fromDMA && acc_scale_unit.io.out.bits.acc_bank_id === i.U) {
680	        acc_scale_unit.io.out.ready := io.acc.read_resp(i).ready
681	        io.acc.read_resp(i).valid := acc_scale_unit.io.out.valid
682	      }
683	    }
684	
685	    val acc_adders = Module(new AccPipeShared(acc_latency-1, acc_row_t, acc_banks))
686	
687	    val acc_mems = {
688	      val banks = Seq.fill(acc_banks) { Module(new AccumulatorMem(
689	        acc_bank_entries, acc_row_t, acc_scale_func, acc_scale_t.asInstanceOf[V],
690	        acc_singleported, acc_sub_banks,
691	        use_shared_ext_mem, use_tl_ext_mem,
692	        acc_latency, accType, is_dummy
693	      )) }
694	      val bank_ios = VecInit(banks.map(_.io))
695	
696	      // Getting the output of the bank that's about to be issued to the writer
697	      val bank_issued_io = bank_ios(write_issue_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.acc_bank())
698	
699	      // Reading from the Accumulator banks
700	      bank_ios.zipWithIndex.foreach { case (bio, i) =>
701	        if (use_shared_ext_mem) {
702	          io.ext_mem.get.acc(i) <> bio.ext_mem.get
703	        }
704	
705	        acc_adders.io.in_sel(i) := bio.adder.valid
706	        acc_adders.io.ina(i) := bio.adder.op1
707	        acc_adders.io.inb(i) := bio.adder.op2
708	        bio.adder.sum := acc_adders.io.out
709	
710	        val ex_read_req = io.acc.read_req(i)
711	        val exread = ex_read_req.valid
712	
713	        // TODO we tie the write dispatch queue's, and write issue queue's, ready and valid signals together here
714	        val dmawrite = write_dispatch_q.valid && write_norm_q.io.enq.ready &&
715	          !write_dispatch_q.bits.laddr.is_garbage() &&
716	          write_dispatch_q.bits.laddr.is_acc_addr && write_dispatch_q.bits.laddr.acc_bank() === i.U
717	
718	        bio.read.req.valid := exread || dmawrite
719	        ex_read_req.ready := bio.read.req.ready
720	
721	        // The ExecuteController gets priority when reading from accumulator banks
722	        when (exread) {
723	          bio.read.req.bits.addr := ex_read_req.bits.addr
724	          bio.read.req.bits.act := ex_read_req.bits.act
725	          bio.read.req.bits.igelu_qb := ex_read_req.bits.igelu_qb
726	          bio.read.req.bits.igelu_qc := ex_read_req.bits.igelu_qc
727	          bio.read.req.bits.iexp_qln2 := ex_read_req.bits.iexp_qln2
728	          bio.read.req.bits.iexp_qln2_inv := ex_read_req.bits.iexp_qln2_inv
729	          bio.read.req.bits.scale := ex_read_req.bits.scale
730	          bio.read.req.bits.full := false.B
731	          bio.read.req.bits.fromDMA := false.B
732	        }.elsewhen (dmawrite) {
733	          bio.read.req.bits.addr := write_dispatch_q.bits.laddr.acc_row()
734	          bio.read.req.bits.full := write_dispatch_q.bits.laddr.read_full_acc_row
735	          bio.read.req.bits.act := write_dispatch_q.bits.acc_act
736	          bio.read.req.bits.igelu_qb := write_dispatch_q.bits.acc_igelu_qb.asTypeOf(bio.read.req.bits.igelu_qb)
737	          bio.read.req.bits.igelu_qc := write_dispatch_q.bits.acc_igelu_qc.asTypeOf(bio.read.req.bits.igelu_qc)
738	          bio.read.req.bits.iexp_qln2 := write_dispatch_q.bits.acc_iexp_qln2.asTypeOf(bio.read.req.bits.iexp_qln2)
739	          bio.read.req.bits.iexp_qln2_inv := write_dispatch_q.bits.acc_iexp_qln2_inv.asTypeOf(bio.read.req.bits.iexp_qln2_inv)
740	          bio.read.req.bits.scale := write_dispatch_q.bits.acc_scale.asTypeOf(bio.read.req.bits.scale)
741	          bio.read.req.bits.fromDMA := true.B
742	
743	          when (bio.read.req.fire) {
744	            write_dispatch_q.ready := true.B
745	            write_norm_q.io.enq.valid := true.B
746	
747	            io.dma.write.resp.valid := true.B
748	          }
749	        }.otherwise {
750	          bio.read.req.bits := DontCare
751	        }
752	        bio.read.resp.ready := false.B
753	
754	        when (write_norm_q.io.deq.valid &&
755	          acc_norm_unit_in.ready &&
756	          bio.read.resp.valid &&
757	          write_scale_q.io.enq.ready &&
758	          write_norm_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.is_acc_addr &&
759	          !write_norm_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.is_garbage() &&
760	          write_norm_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.acc_bank() === i.U)
761	        {
762	          write_norm_q.io.deq.ready := true.B
763	          acc_norm_unit_in.valid := true.B
764	          bio.read.resp.ready := true.B
765	
766	          // Some normalizer commands don't write to main memory, so they don't need to be passed on to the scaling units
767	          write_scale_q.io.enq.valid := NormCmd.writes_to_main_memory(write_norm_q.io.deq.bits.laddr.norm_cmd)
768	
769	          acc_norm_unit_in.bits.acc_read_resp := bio.read.resp.bits
770	          acc_norm_unit_in.bits.acc_read_resp.acc_bank_id := i.U
771	        }
772	      }
773	
774	      // Writing to the accumulator banks
775	      bank_ios.zipWithIndex.foreach { case (bio, i) =>
776	        // Order of precedence during writes is ExecuteController, and then mvin_scale, and then mvin_scale_acc, and
777	        // then zero_writer
778	
779	        val exwrite = io.acc.write(i).valid
780	        io.acc.write(i).ready := true.B
781	        assert(!(exwrite && !bio.write.ready), "Execute controller write to AccumulatorMem was skipped")
782	
783	        // val from_mvin_scale = mvin_scale_out.valid && mvin_scale_out.bits.tag.is_acc
784	        val from_mvin_scale = mvin_scale_pixel_repeater.io.resp.valid && mvin_scale_pixel_repeater.io.resp.bits.tag.is_acc
785	        val from_mvin_scale_acc = mvin_scale_acc_out.valid && mvin_scale_acc_out.bits.tag.is_acc
786	
787	        // val mvin_scale_laddr = mvin_scale_out.bits.tag.addr.asTypeOf(local_addr_t) + mvin_scale_out.bits.row
788	        val mvin_scale_laddr = mvin_scale_pixel_repeater.io.resp.bits.laddr
789	        val mvin_scale_acc_laddr = mvin_scale_acc_out.bits.tag.addr.asTypeOf(local_addr_t) + mvin_scale_acc_out.bits.row
790	
791	        val dmaread_bank = Mux(from_mvin_scale, mvin_scale_laddr.acc_bank(),
792	          mvin_scale_acc_laddr.acc_bank())
793	        val dmaread_row = Mux(from_mvin_scale, mvin_scale_laddr.acc_row(), mvin_scale_acc_laddr.acc_row())
794	
795	        // We need to make sure that we don't try to return a dma read resp from both mvin_scale and mvin_scale_acc
796	        // at the same time. mvin_scale always gets priority in this cases
797	        val spad_last = mvin_scale_pixel_repeater.io.resp.valid && mvin_scale_pixel_repeater.io.resp.bits.last && !mvin_scale_pixel_repeater.io.resp.bits.tag.is_acc
798	
799	        val dmaread = (from_mvin_scale || from_mvin_scale_acc) &&
800	          dmaread_bank === i.U /* &&
801	          (mvin_scale_same.B || from_mvin_scale || !spad_dmaread_last) */
802	
803	        // We need to make sure that we don't try to return a dma read resp from both zero_writer and either mvin_scale
804	        // or mvin_acc_scale at the same time. The scalers always get priority in those cases
805	        /* val zerowrite = zero_writer.io.resp.valid && zero_writer.io.resp.bits.laddr.is_acc_addr &&
806	          zero_writer.io.resp.bits.laddr.acc_bank() === i.U && */
807	        val zerowrite = zero_writer_pixel_repeater.io.resp.valid && zero_writer_pixel_repeater.io.resp.bits.laddr.is_acc_addr &&
808	          zero_writer_pixel_repeater.io.resp.bits.laddr.acc_bank() === i.U &&
809	          // !((mvin_scale_out.valid && mvin_scale_out.bits.last) || (mvin_scale_acc_out.valid && mvin_scale_acc_out.bits.last))
810	          !((mvin_scale_pixel_repeater.io.resp.valid && mvin_scale_pixel_repeater.io.resp.bits.last) || (mvin_scale_acc_out.valid && mvin_scale_acc_out.bits.last))
811	
812	        val consecutive_write_block = RegInit(false.B)
813	        if (acc_singleported) {
814	          val consecutive_write_sub_bank = RegInit(0.U((1 max log2Ceil(acc_sub_banks)).W))
815	          when (bio.write.fire && bio.write.bits.acc &&
816	            (bio.write.bits.addr(log2Ceil(acc_sub_banks)-1,0) === consecutive_write_sub_bank)) {
817	            consecutive_write_block := true.B
818	          } .elsewhen (bio.write.fire && bio.write.bits.acc) {
819	            consecutive_write_block := false.B
820	            consecutive_write_sub_bank := bio.write.bits.addr(log2Ceil(acc_sub_banks)-1,0)
821	          } .otherwise {
822	            consecutive_write_block := false.B
823	          }
824	        }
825	        bio.write.valid := false.B
826	
827	        // bio.write.bits.acc := MuxCase(zero_writer.io.resp.bits.laddr.accumulate,
828	        bio.write.bits.acc := MuxCase(zero_writer_pixel_repeater.io.resp.bits.laddr.accumulate,
829	          Seq(exwrite -> io.acc.write(i).bits.acc,
830	            // from_mvin_scale -> mvin_scale_out.bits.tag.accumulate,
831	            from_mvin_scale -> mvin_scale_pixel_repeater.io.resp.bits.tag.accumulate,
832	            from_mvin_scale_acc -> mvin_scale_acc_out.bits.tag.accumulate))
833	
834	        // bio.write.bits.addr := MuxCase(zero_writer.io.resp.bits.laddr.acc_row(),
835	        bio.write.bits.addr := MuxCase(zero_writer_pixel_repeater.io.resp.bits.laddr.acc_row(),
836	          Seq(exwrite -> io.acc.write(i).bits.addr,
837	            (from_mvin_scale || from_mvin_scale_acc) -> dmaread_row))
838	
839	        when (exwrite) {
840	          bio.write.valid := true.B
841	          bio.write.bits.data := io.acc.write(i).bits.data
842	          bio.write.bits.mask := io.acc.write(i).bits.mask
843	        }.elsewhen (dmaread && !spad_last && !consecutive_write_block) {
844	          bio.write.valid := true.B
845	          bio.write.bits.data := Mux(from_mvin_scale,
846	            // VecInit(mvin_scale_out.bits.out.map(e => e.withWidthOf(accType))).asTypeOf(acc_row_t),
847	            VecInit(mvin_scale_pixel_repeater.io.resp.bits.out.map(e => e.withWidthOf(accType))).asTypeOf(acc_row_t),
848	            mvin_scale_acc_out.bits.out.asTypeOf(acc_row_t))
849	          bio.write.bits.mask :=
850	            Mux(from_mvin_scale,
851	              {
852	                val n = accType.getWidth / inputType.getWidth
853	                // val mask = mvin_scale_out.bits.tag.mask take ((spad_w / (aligned_to * 8)) max 1)
854	                val mask = mvin_scale_pixel_repeater.io.resp.bits.mask take ((spad_w / (aligned_to * 8)) max 1)
855	                val expanded = VecInit(mask.flatMap(e => Seq.fill(n)(e)))
856	                expanded
857	              },
858	              mvin_scale_acc_out.bits.tag.mask)
859	
860	          when(from_mvin_scale) {
861	            mvin_scale_pixel_repeater.io.resp.ready := bio.write.ready
862	          }.otherwise {
863	            mvin_scale_acc_out.ready := bio.write.ready
864	          }
865	        }.elsewhen (zerowrite && !spad_last && !consecutive_write_block) {
866	          bio.write.valid := true.B
867	          bio.write.bits.data := 0.U.asTypeOf(acc_row_t)
868	          bio.write.bits.mask := {
869	            val n = accType.getWidth / inputType.getWidth
870	            val mask = zero_writer_pixel_repeater.io.resp.bits.mask
871	            val expanded = VecInit(mask.flatMap(e => Seq.fill(n)(e)))
872	            expanded
873	          }
874	
875	          zero_writer_pixel_repeater.io.resp.ready := bio.write.ready
876	        }.otherwise {
877	          bio.write.bits.data := DontCare
878	          bio.write.bits.mask := DontCare
879	        }
880	      }
881	      banks
882	    }
883	
884	    // Counter connection
885	    io.counter := DontCare
886	    io.counter.collect(reader.module.io.counter)
887	    io.counter.collect(writer.module.io.counter)
888	    spad_writer.foreach(_.module.io.counter := DontCare)
889	//    io.counter.collect(spad_writer.module.io.counter)
890	  }
891	}

73	class AccPipeShared[T <: Data : Arithmetic](latency: Int, t: Vec[Vec[T]], banks: Int) extends Module {
74	  val io = IO(new Bundle {

76	    val ina = Input(Vec(banks, t.cloneType))

92	class AccumulatorMem[T <: Data, U <: Data](
93	  n: Int, t: Vec[Vec[T]], scale_func: (T, U) => T, scale_t: U,
94	  acc_singleported: Boolean, acc_sub_banks: Int,
95	  use_shared_ext_mem: Boolean, use_tl_ext_ram: Boolean,
96	  acc_latency: Int, acc_type: T, is_dummy: Boolean
97	)
98	  (implicit ev: Arithmetic[T]) extends Module {
99	  // TODO Do writes in this module work with matrices of size 2? If we try to read from an address right after writing
100	  // to it, then we might not get the written data. We might need some kind of cooldown counter after addresses in the
101	  // accumulator have been written to for configurations with such small matrices
102	
103	  // TODO make a new aligned_to variable specifically for AccumulatorMem. We should assume that inputs are at least
104	  // accType.getWidth/8 aligned, because it won't make sense to do matrix additions directly in the DMA otherwise.
105	
106	  import ev._
107	
108	  // TODO unify this with TwoPortSyncMemIO
109	  val io = IO(new AccumulatorMemIO(n, t, scale_t, acc_sub_banks, use_shared_ext_mem))
110	
111	  require (acc_latency >= 2)
112	
113	  val pipelined_writes = Reg(Vec(acc_latency, Valid(new AccumulatorWriteReq(n, t))))
114	  val oldest_pipelined_write = pipelined_writes(acc_latency-1)
115	  pipelined_writes(0).valid := io.write.fire
116	  pipelined_writes(0).bits  := io.write.bits
117	  for (i <- 1 until acc_latency) {
118	    pipelined_writes(i) := pipelined_writes(i-1)
119	  }
120	
121	  val rdata_for_adder = Wire(t)
122	  rdata_for_adder := DontCare
123	  val rdata_for_read_resp = Wire(t)
124	  rdata_for_read_resp := DontCare
125	
126	  val adder_sum = io.adder.sum
127	  io.adder.valid := pipelined_writes(0).valid && pipelined_writes(0).bits.acc
128	  io.adder.op1 := rdata_for_adder
129	  io.adder.op2 := pipelined_writes(0).bits.data
130	
131	  val block_read_req = WireInit(false.B)
132	  val block_write_req = WireInit(false.B)
133	
134	  val mask_len = t.getWidth / 8
135	  val mask_elem = UInt((t.getWidth / mask_len).W)
136

151	
152	  val cmd_tracker_max_rows = ((block_rows * max_blocks) max
153	    (((1 << pool_orows.getWidth)-1) * ((1 << pool_ocols.getWidth)-1) + 2*((1 << pool_lpad.getWidth)-1) + 2*((1 << pool_upad.getWidth)-1))) min
154	    ((config.sp_banks * config.sp_bank_entries) max
155	    (config.acc_banks * config.acc_bank_entries))
156	
157	  val cmd_tracker = Module(new DMACommandTracker(nCmds, cmd_tracker_max_rows, deps_t))
158	
159	  // DMA IO wiring
160	  io.dma.req.valid := (control_state === waiting_for_command && cmd.valid && DoStore && cmd_tracker.io.alloc.ready) ||
161	    control_state === waiting_for_dma_req_ready ||
162	    (control_state === sending_rows && (block_counter =/= 0.U || row_counter =/= 0.U)) ||
163	    (control_state === pooling && (wcol_counter =/= 0.U || wrow_counter =/= 0.U || pocol_counter =/= 0.U || porow_counter =/= 0.U))
164	
165	  io.dma.req.bits.vaddr := Mux(dst_is_spad,
166	    current_dst_spad_addr,
167	    Mux(pooling_is_enabled || mvout_1d_enabled, pool_vaddr, current_vaddr))
168	  io.dma.req.bits.dest := dst_is_spad
169	  io.dma.req.bits.laddr := Mux(pooling_is_enabled, pool_row_addr, current_localaddr) //Todo: laddr for 1D?
170	  io.dma.req.bits.laddr.norm_cmd := Mux(block_counter === blocks - 1.U, current_localaddr.norm_cmd,
171	        NormCmd.non_reset_version(current_localaddr.norm_cmd))
172	
173	  io.dma.req.bits.acc_act := activation
174	  io.dma.req.bits.acc_igelu_qb := igelu_qb.asTypeOf(io.dma.req.bits.acc_igelu_qb)
175	  io.dma.req.bits.acc_igelu_qc := igelu_qc.asTypeOf(io.dma.req.bits.acc_igelu_qc)
176	  io.dma.req.bits.acc_iexp_qln2 := iexp_qln2.asTypeOf(io.dma.req.bits.acc_iexp_qln2)
177	  io.dma.req.bits.acc_iexp_qln2_inv := iexp_qln2_inv.asTypeOf(io.dma.req.bits.acc_iexp_qln2_inv)
178	  io.dma.req.bits.acc_norm_stats_id := norm_stats_id
179	  io.dma.req.bits.acc_scale := acc_scale.asTypeOf(io.dma.req.bits.acc_scale)
180	
181	  io.dma.req.bits.len := Mux(block_counter === blocks - 1.U, ((cols - 1.U) % block_cols.U) + 1.U, block_cols.U)
182	  io.dma.req.bits.block := block_counter
183	  io.dma.req.bits.status := mstatus
184	  io.dma.req.bits.pool_en := pooling_is_enabled && (wrow_counter =/= 0.U || wcol_counter =/= 0.U)
185	  io.dma.req.bits.store_en := Mux(pooling_is_enabled, wrow_counter === pool_size - 1.U && wcol_counter === pool_size - 1.U,
186	    block_counter === blocks - 1.U)
187	
188	  // Command tracker IO
189	  cmd_tracker.io.alloc.valid := control_state === waiting_for_command && cmd.valid && DoStore
190	  cmd_tracker.io.alloc.bits.bytes_to_read := Mux(!pooling_is_enabled, Mux(mvout_1d_enabled, mvout_1d_rows, rows*blocks), pool_total_rows) // TODO do we have to add upad and lpad to this?
191	  cmd_tracker.io.alloc.bits.tag.rob_id := cmd.bits.rob_id.bits
192	
193	  cmd_tracker.io.request_returned.valid := io.dma.resp.fire // TODO use a bundle connect
194	  cmd_tracker.io.request_returned.bits.cmd_id := io.dma.resp.bits.cmd_id // TODO use a bundle connect
195	  cmd_tracker.io.request_returned.bits.bytes_read := 1.U
196	  cmd_tracker.io.cmd_completed.ready := io.completed.ready
197	
198	  val cmd_id = RegEnableThru(cmd_tracker.io.alloc.bits.cmd_id, cmd_tracker.io.alloc.fire()) // TODO is this really better than a simple RegEnable?
199	  io.dma.req.bits.cmd_id := cmd_id
200	
201	  io.completed.valid := cmd_tracker.io.cmd_completed.valid
202	  io.completed.bits := cmd_tracker.io.cmd_completed.bits.tag.rob_id
203	
204	  io.busy := cmd.valid || cmd_tracker.io.busy
205	
206	  // Row counter
207	  when (io.dma.req.fire) {
208	    when (!pooling_is_enabled) {
209	      //where does rows come from?
210	      //row_counter := wrappingAdd(row_counter, 1.U, rows)
211	      when(mvout_1d_enabled){
212	        pocol_counter := wrappingAdd(pocol_counter, 1.U, pool_ocols)
213	        porow_counter := wrappingAdd(porow_counter, 1.U, pool_orows, pocol_counter === pool_ocols - 1.U)
214	      }
215	
216	      block_counter := wrappingAdd(block_counter, 1.U, blocks)
217	      row_counter := Mux(mvout_1d_enabled, wrappingAdd(row_counter, 1.U, mvout_1d_rows), wrappingAdd(row_counter, 1.U, rows, block_counter === blocks - 1.U))
218	    }.otherwise {
219	      wcol_counter := wrappingAdd(wcol_counter, 1.U, pool_size)
220	      wrow_counter := wrappingAdd(wrow_counter, 1.U, pool_size, wcol_counter === pool_size - 1.U)
221	      pocol_counter := wrappingAdd(pocol_counter, 1.U, pool_pocols, wrow_counter === pool_size - 1.U && wcol_counter === pool_size - 1.U)
222	      porow_counter := wrappingAdd(porow_counter, 1.U, pool_porows, pocol_counter === pool_pocols - 1.U && wrow_counter === pool_size - 1.U && wcol_counter === pool_size - 1.U)
223	    }
224	
225	    assert(!(io.dma.req.bits.laddr.read_full_acc_row && blocks > 1.U), "Block-mvouts are not permitted when moving out full accumulator data")
226	    assert(!((pooling_is_enabled || mvout_1d_enabled) && blocks > 1.U), "Block-mvouts are not permitted when pooling")
227	  }
228	
229	  // Control logic
230	  switch (control_state) {
231	    is (waiting_for_command) {
232	      when (cmd.valid) {
233	        when(DoConfig) {
234	          stride := config_stride
235	
236	          activation := config_activation
237	          when (!config_acc_scale.asUInt.andR) {
238	            acc_scale := config_acc_scale.asTypeOf(acc_scale_t)
239	          }
240	
241	          pool_size := config_pool_size
242	          pool_stride := config_pool_stride
243	          when (config_pool_stride =/= 0.U) {
244	            pool_out_dim := config_pool_out_dim
245	            pool_porows := config_porows
246	            pool_pocols := config_pocols
247	            pool_orows := config_orows
248	            pool_ocols := config_ocols
249	            pool_upad := config_upad
250	            pool_lpad := config_lpad
251	          }.elsewhen(config_pool_size =/= 0.U){
252	            pool_orows := config_orows
253	            pool_ocols := config_ocols
254	            pool_out_dim := config_pool_out_dim
255	          }
256	          cmd.ready := true.B
257	        }
258	        .elsewhen(config.has_normalizations.B && DoConfigNorm) {
259	          when (!config_set_stats_id_only.asBool) {
260	            igelu_qb := config_igelu_qb.asTypeOf(igelu_qb)
261	            igelu_qc := config_igelu_qc.asTypeOf(igelu_qc)
262	            when(config_iexp_q_const_type === 0.U) {
263	              iexp_qln2 := config_iexp_q_const.asTypeOf(iexp_qln2)
264	            }.elsewhen(config_iexp_q_const_type === 1.U) {
265	              iexp_qln2_inv := config_iexp_q_const.asTypeOf(iexp_qln2_inv)
266	            }
267	            activation := Cat(config_activation_msb, activation(1, 0)) // TODO: magic number
268	          }
269	          norm_stats_id := config_stats_id
270	          cmd.ready := true.B
271	        }
272	        .elsewhen(DoStore && cmd_tracker.io.alloc.fire()) {
273	          val next_state = Mux(pooling_is_enabled, pooling, sending_rows)
274	          control_state := Mux(io.dma.req.fire, next_state, waiting_for_dma_req_ready)
275	        }
276	      }
277	    }
278	
279	    is (waiting_for_dma_req_ready) {
280	      when (io.dma.req.fire) {
281	        control_state := Mux(pooling_is_enabled, pooling, sending_rows)
282	      }
283	    }
284	
285	    is (sending_rows) {
286	      val last_block = block_counter === blocks - 1.U && io.dma.req.fire
287	      val last_row = Mux(mvout_1d_enabled, row_counter === mvout_1d_rows - 1.U, row_counter === rows - 1.U) && io.dma.req.fire
288	      //normal mvout: row, 1D mvout: orows*ocols
289	
290	      val only_one_dma_req = block_counter === 0.U && row_counter === 0.U // This is a special case when only one DMA request is made
291	
292	      when ((last_block && last_row) || only_one_dma_req) {
293	        control_state := waiting_for_command
294	        cmd.ready := true.B
295	      }
296	    }
297	
298	    is (pooling) {
299	      // TODO Is it really possible for all the counters to be 0 here?
300	      val last_row = (porow_counter === 0.U && pocol_counter === 0.U && wrow_counter === 0.U && wcol_counter === 0.U) ||
301	        (porow_counter === pool_porows - 1.U && pocol_counter === pool_pocols - 1.U &&
302	          wrow_counter === pool_size - 1.U && wcol_counter === pool_size - 1.U && io.dma.req.fire)
303	
304	      when (last_row) {
305	        control_state := waiting_for_command
306	        cmd.ready := true.B
307	      }
308	    }
309	  }
310	
311	  // Optimizations when features are disabled
312	  if (!config.has_normalizations) {
313	    current_localaddr.norm_cmd := NormCmd.RESET
314	
315	    igelu_qb := DontCare
316	    igelu_qc := DontCare
317	    iexp_qln2 := DontCare
318	    iexp_qln2_inv := DontCare
319	    norm_stats_id := 0.U
320	  }
321	
322	  // Performance counter
323	  CounterEventIO.init(io.counter)
324	  io.counter.connectEventSignal(CounterEvent.STORE_ACTIVE_CYCLE, control_state === sending_rows || control_state === pooling)
325	  io.counter.connectEventSignal(CounterEvent.STORE_POOLING_CYCLE, pooling_is_enabled)
326	  io.counter.connectEventSignal(CounterEvent.STORE_DMA_WAIT_CYCLE, control_state === waiting_for_dma_req_ready)
327	  io.counter.connectEventSignal(CounterEvent.STORE_SCRATCHPAD_WAIT_CYCLE, io.dma.req.valid && !io.dma.req.ready)
328	
329	  if (use_firesim_simulation_counters) {
330	    PerfCounter(pooling_is_enabled, "pooling_cycles", "cycles during which store controller is max-pooling")
331	    PerfCounter(io.dma.req.valid && !io.dma.req.ready, "st_dma_wait_cycle", "cycles during which store controller is stalling for the DMA to be ready")
332	  }
333	}

"""Front-end parsing of the frozen ``merlin_iface`` grammar (v0.1) into a small
normalized program IR.

This is the *front end* only: it reads the contract text into Python dataclasses.
The genuine compiler work (IRDL dialects + verifiers + a rewrite pass) happens on
top of this IR (see ``dialect_iface``/``dialect_gemmini``/``lower``).

The grammar is documented in ``bench_contract/interface_grammar.md``. We parse it with
a few regexes (the grammar is deliberately regular). We support the five core ops
(tensor / resident_pack / matmul / commit / evict) plus the two Gemmini extension ops
that appear in the capsule corpus: ``movement`` (pure mvin/mvout copy) and ``conv2d``
(im2col-lowered convolution).

No ``merlin`` import: this module depends only on the stdlib, so the shipped package
stays integrity-clean.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

GRAMMAR_VERSION = "0.1"


@dataclass
class Tensor:
    name: str
    shape: list[int]
    dtype: str
    role: str


@dataclass
class Pack:
    dst: str          # resident handle ssa name
    src: str          # weight tensor name
    layout: str


@dataclass
class Matmul:
    dst: str          # accumulator ssa name
    lhs: str          # input tensor name
    rhs: str          # resident handle ssa name


@dataclass
class Commit:
    dst: str          # output tensor name
    src: str          # accumulator ssa name
    epilogue: list[str]
    output_dtype: str
    acc_scale: float | None = None


@dataclass
class Movement:
    dst: str          # output tensor name
    src: str          # input tensor name


@dataclass
class Conv2d:
    dst: str          # output tensor name (im2col matmul result, [n_patches, out_ch])
    ifm: str          # input feature map tensor name (NHWC)
    rhs: str          # resident weight handle ssa name
    kernel: list[int]  # [kh, kw, ci, co]
    stride: list[int]
    padding: list[int]
    dilation: list[int]
    layout: str
    epilogue: list[str]
    output_dtype: str
    acc_scale: float | None = None


@dataclass
class Evict:
    handle: str


@dataclass
class Program:
    version: str
    target: str
    abi_version: str
    tensors: dict[str, Tensor] = field(default_factory=dict)
    ops: list[Any] = field(default_factory=list)
    # ssa name -> tensor name it refers to (handles map to their packed weight)
    pack_src: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)


_RE_MOD = re.compile(r"module\s+attributes\s*\{([^}]*)\}")
_RE_TENSOR = re.compile(
    r"%(\S+)\s*=\s*merlin_iface\.tensor\s*\{([^}]*)\}\s*:\s*tensor<([^>]+)>")
_RE_PACK = re.compile(
    r"%(\S+)\s*=\s*merlin_iface\.resident_pack\s*%(\S+)\s*\{([^}]*)\}")
_RE_MATMUL = re.compile(
    r"%(\S+)\s*=\s*merlin_iface\.matmul\s*%(\S+),\s*%(\S+)\s*:")
_RE_COMMIT = re.compile(
    r"%(\S+)\s*=\s*merlin_iface\.commit\s*%(\S+)\s*\{([^}]*)\}\s*:")
_RE_MOVEMENT = re.compile(
    r"%(\S+)\s*=\s*merlin_iface\.movement\s*%(\S+)\s*\{([^}]*)\}\s*:")
_RE_CONV = re.compile(
    r"%(\S+)\s*=\s*merlin_iface\.conv2d\s*%(\S+),\s*%(\S+)\s*\{([^}]*)\}\s*:")
_RE_EVICT = re.compile(r"merlin_iface\.evict\s*%(\S+)")


def _shape(s: str) -> tuple[list[int], str]:
    parts = s.split("x")
    dtype = parts[-1]
    dims = [int(p) for p in parts[:-1]]
    return dims, dtype


def _parse_attrs(body: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    depth = 0
    cur = ""
    parts: list[str] = []
    for ch in body:
        if ch == "[":
            depth += 1
        elif ch == "]":
            depth -= 1
        if ch == "," and depth == 0:
            parts.append(cur)
            cur = ""
        else:
            cur += ch
    if cur.strip():
        parts.append(cur)
    for part in parts:
        if "=" not in part:
            continue
        k, v = part.split("=", 1)
        out[k.strip()] = _parse_value(v.strip())
    return out


def _parse_value(v: str) -> Any:
    v = v.strip()
    if v.startswith("[") and v.endswith("]"):
        body = v[1:-1].strip()
        if not body:
            return []
        return [_parse_value(x) for x in body.split(",")]
    if v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"'):
        return v[1:-1]
    num = v.split(":")[0].strip()
    if re.fullmatch(r"[-+]?\d+", num):
        return int(num)
    try:
        return float(num)
    except ValueError:
        return num


class ParseError(Exception):
    pass


def parse_program(text: str) -> Program:
    mod = _RE_MOD.search(text)
    mattrs = _parse_attrs(mod.group(1)) if mod else {}
    prog = Program(
        version=str(mattrs.get("merlin_iface.version", "")),
        target=str(mattrs.get("merlin_iface.target", "")),
        abi_version=str(mattrs.get("merlin_iface.abi_version", "0.1")),
    )

    for raw in text.splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("//"):
            continue

        m = _RE_TENSOR.search(line)
        if m:
            attrs = _parse_attrs(m.group(2))
            dims, dtype = _shape(m.group(3))
            name = attrs.get("name", m.group(1))
            prog.tensors[name] = Tensor(name, dims, dtype, attrs.get("role", "input"))
            continue

        m = _RE_PACK.search(line)
        if m:
            dst, src = m.group(1), m.group(2)
            attrs = _parse_attrs(m.group(3))
            prog.ops.append(Pack(dst=dst, src=src, layout=attrs.get("layout", "packed_rhs")))
            prog.pack_src[dst] = src
            continue

        m = _RE_MATMUL.search(line)
        if m:
            prog.ops.append(Matmul(dst=m.group(1), lhs=m.group(2), rhs=m.group(3)))
            continue

        m = _RE_COMMIT.search(line)
        if m:
            ssa, src = m.group(1), m.group(2)
            attrs = _parse_attrs(m.group(3))
            dst = attrs.get("name", ssa)
            prog.ops.append(Commit(
                dst=dst, src=src,
                epilogue=list(attrs.get("epilogue", [])),
                output_dtype=str(attrs.get("output_dtype", "i32")),
                acc_scale=attrs.get("acc_scale")))
            continue

        m = _RE_MOVEMENT.search(line)
        if m:
            ssa, src = m.group(1), m.group(2)
            attrs = _parse_attrs(m.group(3))
            prog.ops.append(Movement(dst=attrs.get("name", ssa), src=src))
            continue

        m = _RE_CONV.search(line)
        if m:
            ssa, ifm, rhs = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
            attrs = _parse_attrs(m.group(4))
            prog.ops.append(Conv2d(
                dst=attrs.get("name", ssa), ifm=ifm, rhs=rhs,
                kernel=list(attrs.get("kernel", [])),
                stride=list(attrs.get("stride", [1, 1])),
                padding=list(attrs.get("padding", [0, 0, 0, 0])),
                dilation=list(attrs.get("dilation", [1, 1])),
                layout=str(attrs.get("layout", "nhwc")),
                epilogue=list(attrs.get("epilogue", [])),
                output_dtype=str(attrs.get("output_dtype", "i32")),
                acc_scale=attrs.get("acc_scale")))
            continue

        m = _RE_EVICT.search(line)
        if m:
            prog.ops.append(Evict(handle=m.group(1)))
            continue

    return prog

"""Build the ``merlin_iface`` module from the parsed program, and lower it to the
``gemmini`` target dialect.

``build_iface_module`` materializes the parsed :class:`~iface_ir.Program` as a real
xDSL module of ``merlin_iface`` ops wrapped in a ``func.func`` (so it round-trips and
``verify()``s). ``lower_to_gemmini`` is the conversion pass: it walks the verified
interface module and constructs the corresponding ``gemmini`` target module (also
verified). This is the genuine dialect + lowering-pass path the arm asks for.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from xdsl.dialects.builtin import (ArrayAttr, FloatAttr, Float32Type, IntegerAttr,
                                    IntegerType, ModuleOp, StringAttr, TensorType,
                                    FunctionType, i32)
from xdsl.dialects.func import FuncOp, ReturnOp
from xdsl.ir import Block, Region

from . import dialects as D
from . import iface_ir as IR


def dtype_to_type(dt: str):
    return IntegerType(int(dt[1:]))


def _tt(dtype: str, shape):
    return TensorType(dtype_to_type(dtype), list(shape))


def _arr(strs):
    return ArrayAttr([StringAttr(s) for s in strs])


def _iarr(ints):
    return ArrayAttr([IntegerAttr(int(v), i32) for v in ints])


def _f32(v):
    return FloatAttr(float(v), Float32Type())


def matmul_out_shape(prog: IR.Program, mm: IR.Matmul):
    """(M, N) for a matmul: M = lhs rows, N = resident weight cols."""
    lhs_t = prog.tensors[mm.lhs]
    w_name = prog.pack_src[mm.rhs]
    w_t = prog.tensors[w_name]
    return int(lhs_t.shape[0]), int(w_t.shape[1])


def conv_out_shape(prog: IR.Program, cv: IR.Conv2d):
    """(n_patches, out_channels) of the im2col matmul.

    n_patches = batch * out_h * out_w; out_channels from the weight cols.
    """
    ifm = prog.tensors[cv.ifm]
    n, h, w, _ci = ifm.shape  # NHWC
    kh, kw = int(cv.kernel[0]), int(cv.kernel[1])
    sh, sw = int(cv.stride[0]), int(cv.stride[1])
    pt, pl, pb, pr = (list(cv.padding) + [0, 0, 0, 0])[:4]
    oh = (h + pt + pb - kh) // sh + 1
    ow = (w + pl + pr - kw) // sw + 1
    n_patches = n * oh * ow
    w_t = prog.tensors[cv.rhs] if cv.rhs in prog.tensors else prog.tensors[prog.pack_src[cv.rhs]]
    co = int(w_t.shape[1])
    return int(n_patches), int(co)


def build_iface_module(prog: IR.Program) -> ModuleOp:
    blk = Block()
    vals: dict[str, object] = {}
    ops = []

    for op in prog.ops:
        if isinstance(op, IR.Pack):
            pass  # handled when we hit it below
    # Emit leaf tensors first (declaration order), then ops in program order.
    for name, t in prog.tensors.items():
        o = D.IfaceTensorOp(
            result_types=[_tt(t.dtype, t.shape)],
            properties={"tname": StringAttr(name), "role": StringAttr(t.role)})
        ops.append(o)
        vals[name] = o.res

    for op in prog.ops:
        if isinstance(op, IR.Pack):
            src = vals[op.src]
            o = D.IfaceResidentPackOp(
                operands=[src],
                result_types=[D.IfaceResidentType(src.type)],
                properties={"layout": StringAttr(op.layout)})
            ops.append(o)
            vals[op.dst] = o.res
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Matmul):
            m, n = matmul_out_shape(prog, op)
            o = D.IfaceMatmulOp(
                operands=[vals[op.lhs], vals[op.rhs]],
                result_types=[D.IfaceAccType(TensorType(i32, [m, n]))])
            ops.append(o)
            vals[op.dst] = o.acc
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Commit):
            acc_t = vals[op.src].type.element
            m, n = acc_t.get_shape()
            props = {"tname": StringAttr(op.dst), "epilogue": _arr(op.epilogue),
                     "output_dtype": StringAttr(op.output_dtype)}
            if op.acc_scale is not None:
                props["acc_scale"] = _f32(op.acc_scale)
            o = D.IfaceCommitOp(
                operands=[vals[op.src]],
                result_types=[_tt(op.output_dtype, [m, n])],
                properties=props)
            ops.append(o)
            vals[op.dst] = o.res
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Movement):
            src = vals[op.src]
            o = D.IfaceMovementOp(
                operands=[src], result_types=[src.type],
                properties={"tname": StringAttr(op.dst)})
            ops.append(o)
            vals[op.dst] = o.res
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Conv2d):
            np_, co = conv_out_shape(prog, op)
            props = {"tname": StringAttr(op.dst), "kernel": _iarr(op.kernel),
                     "stride": _iarr(op.stride), "padding": _iarr(op.padding),
                     "dilation": _iarr(op.dilation), "layout": StringAttr(op.layout),
                     "epilogue": _arr(op.epilogue),
                     "output_dtype": StringAttr(op.output_dtype)}
            if op.acc_scale is not None:
                props["acc_scale"] = _f32(op.acc_scale)
            o = D.IfaceConv2dOp(
                operands=[vals[op.ifm], vals[op.rhs]],
                result_types=[_tt(op.output_dtype, [np_, co])],
                properties=props)
            ops.append(o)
            vals[op.dst] = o.res

"""Build the ``merlin_iface`` module from the parsed program, and lower it to the
``gemmini`` target dialect.

``build_iface_module`` materializes the parsed :class:`~iface_ir.Program` as a real
xDSL module of ``merlin_iface`` ops wrapped in a ``func.func`` (so it round-trips and
``verify()``s). ``lower_to_gemmini`` is the conversion pass: it walks the verified
interface module and constructs the corresponding ``gemmini`` target module (also
verified). This is the genuine dialect + lowering-pass path the arm asks for.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from xdsl.dialects.builtin import (ArrayAttr, FloatAttr, Float32Type, IntegerAttr,
                                    IntegerType, ModuleOp, StringAttr, TensorType,
                                    FunctionType, i32)
from xdsl.dialects.func import FuncOp, ReturnOp
from xdsl.ir import Block, Region

from . import dialects as D
from . import iface_ir as IR


def dtype_to_type(dt: str):
    return IntegerType(int(dt[1:]))


def _tt(dtype: str, shape):
    return TensorType(dtype_to_type(dtype), list(shape))


def _arr(strs):
    return ArrayAttr([StringAttr(s) for s in strs])


def _iarr(ints):
    return ArrayAttr([IntegerAttr(int(v), i32) for v in ints])


def _f32(v):
    return FloatAttr(float(v), Float32Type())


def matmul_out_shape(prog: IR.Program, mm: IR.Matmul):
    """(M, N) for a matmul: M = lhs rows, N = resident weight cols."""
    lhs_t = prog.tensors[mm.lhs]
    w_name = prog.pack_src[mm.rhs]
    w_t = prog.tensors[w_name]
    return int(lhs_t.shape[0]), int(w_t.shape[1])


def conv_out_shape(prog: IR.Program, cv: IR.Conv2d):
    """(n_patches, out_channels) of the im2col matmul.

    n_patches = batch * out_h * out_w; out_channels from the weight cols.
    """
    ifm = prog.tensors[cv.ifm]
    n, h, w, _ci = ifm.shape  # NHWC
    kh, kw = int(cv.kernel[0]), int(cv.kernel[1])
    sh, sw = int(cv.stride[0]), int(cv.stride[1])
    pt, pl, pb, pr = (list(cv.padding) + [0, 0, 0, 0])[:4]
    oh = (h + pt + pb - kh) // sh + 1
    ow = (w + pl + pr - kw) // sw + 1
    n_patches = n * oh * ow
    w_t = prog.tensors[cv.rhs] if cv.rhs in prog.tensors else prog.tensors[prog.pack_src[cv.rhs]]
    co = int(w_t.shape[1])
    return int(n_patches), int(co)


def build_iface_module(prog: IR.Program) -> ModuleOp:
    blk = Block()
    vals: dict[str, object] = {}
    ops = []

    for op in prog.ops:
        if isinstance(op, IR.Pack):
            pass  # handled when we hit it below
    # Emit leaf tensors first (declaration order), then ops in program order.
    for name, t in prog.tensors.items():
        o = D.IfaceTensorOp(
            result_types=[_tt(t.dtype, t.shape)],
            properties={"tname": StringAttr(name), "role": StringAttr(t.role)})
        ops.append(o)
        vals[name] = o.res

    for op in prog.ops:
        if isinstance(op, IR.Pack):
            src = vals[op.src]
            o = D.IfaceResidentPackOp(
                operands=[src],
                result_types=[D.IfaceResidentType(src.type)],
                properties={"layout": StringAttr(op.layout)})
            ops.append(o)
            vals[op.dst] = o.res
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Matmul):
            m, n = matmul_out_shape(prog, op)
            o = D.IfaceMatmulOp(
                operands=[vals[op.lhs], vals[op.rhs]],
                result_types=[D.IfaceAccType(TensorType(i32, [m, n]))])
            ops.append(o)
            vals[op.dst] = o.acc
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Commit):
            acc_t = vals[op.src].type.element
            m, n = acc_t.get_shape()
            props = {"tname": StringAttr(op.dst), "epilogue": _arr(op.epilogue),
                     "output_dtype": StringAttr(op.output_dtype)}
            if op.acc_scale is not None:
                props["acc_scale"] = _f32(op.acc_scale)
            o = D.IfaceCommitOp(
                operands=[vals[op.src]],
                result_types=[_tt(op.output_dtype, [m, n])],
                properties=props)
            ops.append(o)
            vals[op.dst] = o.res
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Movement):
            src = vals[op.src]
            o = D.IfaceMovementOp(
                operands=[src], result_types=[src.type],
                properties={"tname": StringAttr(op.dst)})
            ops.append(o)
            vals[op.dst] = o.res
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Conv2d):
            np_, co = conv_out_shape(prog, op)
            props = {"tname": StringAttr(op.dst), "kernel": _iarr(op.kernel),
                     "stride": _iarr(op.stride), "padding": _iarr(op.padding),
                     "dilation": _iarr(op.dilation), "layout": StringAttr(op.layout),
                     "epilogue": _arr(op.epilogue),
                     "output_dtype": StringAttr(op.output_dtype)}
            if op.acc_scale is not None:
                props["acc_scale"] = _f32(op.acc_scale)
            o = D.IfaceConv2dOp(
                operands=[vals[op.ifm], vals[op.rhs]],
                result_types=[_tt(op.output_dtype, [np_, co])],
                properties=props)
            ops.append(o)
            vals[op.dst] = o.res
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Evict):
            o = D.IfaceEvictOp(operands=[vals[op.handle]])
            ops.append(o)

    blk.add_ops(ops + [ReturnOp()])
    fn = FuncOp("kernel", FunctionType.from_lists([], []), Region([blk]))
    return ModuleOp([fn])


def _func_block(module: ModuleOp) -> Block:
    fn = next(o for o in module.body.block.ops if isinstance(o, FuncOp))
    return fn.body.block


def lower_to_gemmini(iface_module: ModuleOp) -> ModuleOp:
    """Conversion pass: merlin_iface module -> gemmini target module."""
    src_blk = _func_block(iface_module)
    blk = Block()
    vals: dict[object, object] = {}  # old SSAValue -> new SSAValue
    ops = []

    for op in src_blk.ops:
        if isinstance(op, D.IfaceTensorOp):
            o = D.GemminiTensorOp(result_types=[op.res.type],
                                  properties={"tname": op.tname, "role": op.role})
            ops.append(o); vals[op.res] = o.res
        elif isinstance(op, D.IfaceResidentPackOp):
            src = vals[op.src]
            o = D.GemminiPackOp(operands=[src],
                                result_types=[D.GemminiResidentTensorType(src.type)],
                                properties={"layout": op.layout})
            ops.append(o); vals[op.res] = o.res
        elif isinstance(op, D.IfaceMatmulOp):
            o = D.GemminiMatmulOp(
                operands=[vals[op.lhs], vals[op.rhs]],
                result_types=[D.GemminiAccumulatorType(op.acc.type.element)])
            ops.append(o); vals[op.acc] = o.acc
        elif isinstance(op, D.IfaceCommitOp):
            props = {"tname": op.tname, "epilogue": op.epilogue,
                     "output_dtype": op.output_dtype}
            if op.acc_scale is not None:
                props["acc_scale"] = op.acc_scale
            o = D.GemminiCommitOp(operands=[vals[op.acc]],
                                  result_types=[op.res.type], properties=props)
            ops.append(o); vals[op.res] = o.res
        elif isinstance(op, D.IfaceMovementOp):
            src = vals[op.src]
            o = D.GemminiMovementOp(operands=[src], result_types=[op.res.type],
                                    properties={"tname": op.tname})
            ops.append(o); vals[op.res] = o.res
        elif isinstance(op, D.IfaceConv2dOp):
            props = {"tname": op.tname, "kernel": op.kernel, "stride": op.stride,
                     "padding": op.padding, "dilation": op.dilation,
                     "layout": op.layout, "epilogue": op.epilogue,
                     "output_dtype": op.output_dtype}
            if op.acc_scale is not None:
                props["acc_scale"] = op.acc_scale
            o = D.GemminiConv2dOp(operands=[vals[op.ifm], vals[op.rhs]],
                                  result_types=[op.res.type], properties=props)
            ops.append(o); vals[op.res] = o.res
        elif isinstance(op, D.IfaceEvictOp):
            o = D.GemminiReleaseOp(operands=[vals[op.handle]])
            ops.append(o)

    blk.add_ops(ops + [ReturnOp()])
    fn = FuncOp("gemmini_kernel", FunctionType.from_lists([], []), Region([blk]))
    return ModuleOp([fn])

"""Lower the program to ``llvm.func @gemmini_kernel`` of RoCC ``.insn r 0x7b`` ops.

We perform genuine instruction selection: each high-level op (matmul, commit, movement)
is tiled to a 16x16 weight/output-stationary micro-sequence of real Gemmini RoCC
instructions (CONFIG_EX/LD/ST, MVIN, PRELOAD, COMPUTE_PRELOADED/ACCUMULATE, MVOUT),
mirroring the ``sp_tiled_matmul`` reference in the ISA header. The instruction encodings
(funct7 + rs1/rs2 bit layouts) are taken from ``gemmini.h``.

Each Gemmini instruction is emitted as an LLVM inline-asm op using the exact xcustom.h
template for a no-rd CUSTOM_3 instruction:
    .insn r 0x7b, 0x3, <funct7>, x0, $0, $1     (inputs: rs1, rs2 in "r,r")

The runner links this module's @gemmini_kernel against its own harness, which passes
``ptr weight, ptr lhs_0.., ptr out_0..`` (leaf data, edge-padded to a multiple of 16).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import struct
from typing import Any

from . import iface_ir as IR
from . import passes as P

DIM = 16
BANK_NUM = 4
BANK_ROWS = 4096
SPAD_ROWS = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS  # 16384
ADDR_LEN = 32
GARBAGE = 0xFFFFFFFF

# funct7 opcodes
F_CONFIG = 0
F_MVIN = 2
F_MVOUT = 3
F_COMPUTE_PRELOADED = 4
F_COMPUTE_ACCUMULATE = 5
F_PRELOAD = 6
F_FLUSH = 7

CONFIG_EX = 0
CONFIG_LD = 1
CONFIG_ST = 2

NO_ACTIVATION = 0
RELU = 1
DATAFLOW_OS = 0

ACC_BIT = 1 << (ADDR_LEN - 1)        # bit31: accumulator region
ACCUMULATE_BIT = 1 << (ADDR_LEN - 2)  # bit30: accumulate (vs overwrite)
FULL_BIT = 1 << (ADDR_LEN - 3)        # bit29: full-width (i32) readout


def _f32_bits(x: float) -> int:
    return struct.unpack("<I", struct.pack("<f", x))[0]


IDENT_BITS = _f32_bits(1.0)


def _ceil16(n: int) -> int:
    return ((n + DIM - 1) // DIM) * DIM


class _Instr:
    __slots__ = ("f7", "rs1", "rs2", "comment")

    def __init__(self, f7, rs1, rs2, comment=""):
        self.f7 = f7
        self.rs1 = rs1   # int OR ("addr", arg_index, byte_offset)
        self.rs2 = rs2   # int OR ("addr", ...)
        self.comment = comment


def _rs2_mvmem(rows, cols, spad):
    return (rows << (ADDR_LEN + 16)) | (cols << ADDR_LEN) | (spad & 0xFFFFFFFF)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- planning


class KernelPlan:
    def __init__(self):
        self.args: list[str] = []          # arg name order
        self.arg_index: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.instrs: list[_Instr] = []

    def add_arg(self, name):
        if name not in self.arg_index:
            self.arg_index[name] = len(self.args)
            self.args.append(name)

    def emit(self, f7, rs1, rs2, comment=""):
        self.instrs.append(_Instr(f7, rs1, rs2, comment))


def _config_ex(plan):
    rs1 = (IDENT_BITS << 32) | (1 << 16) | (DATAFLOW_OS << 2) | CONFIG_EX
    rs2 = (1 << 48)  # C_stride=1, in_shift=0
    plan.emit(F_CONFIG, rs1, rs2, "config_ex OS")


def _config_ld(plan, stride_bytes, comment=""):
    rs1 = (IDENT_BITS << 32) | (DIM << 16) | (1 << 8) | CONFIG_LD
    plan.emit(F_CONFIG, rs1, stride_bytes, "config_ld " + comment)


def _config_st(plan, stride_bytes, acc_act, acc_scale):
    rs1 = (acc_act << 2) | CONFIG_ST
    rs2 = (_f32_bits(acc_scale) << 32) | (stride_bytes & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    plan.emit(F_CONFIG, rs1, rs2, "config_st")


def _matmul_tiles(plan, weight_name, lhs_name, out_name, M, K, N,
                  epilogue, output_dtype, acc_scale):
    """Emit the tiled OS matmul + epilogue readout for one matmul/commit pair."""
    Mp, Kp, Np = _ceil16(M), _ceil16(K), _ceil16(N)
    Mt, Kt, Nt = Mp // DIM, Kp // DIM, Np // DIM

    full_C = 1 if output_dtype == "i32" else 0
    sizeof_C = 4 if output_dtype == "i32" else 1
    acc_act = RELU if "relu" in epilogue else NO_ACTIVATION
    scale = float(acc_scale) if (acc_scale is not None and "acc_scale" in epilogue) else 1.0

    w_arg = plan.arg_index[weight_name]
    a_arg = plan.arg_index[lhs_name]
    o_arg = plan.arg_index[out_name]

    A_sp0 = 0
    B_sp0 = SPAD_ROWS - Kt * Nt * DIM

    _config_st(plan, Np * sizeof_C, acc_act, scale)

    # mvin B (weight, the RHS): stride Np
    _config_ld(plan, Np, "B")
    for j in range(Nt):
        for k in range(Kt):
            off = (k * DIM * Np + j * DIM)  # i8 bytes
            spad = B_sp0 + (k * Nt + j) * DIM
            plan.emit(F_MVIN, ("addr", w_arg, off), _rs2_mvmem(DIM, DIM, spad), "mvin B")

    # mvin A (lhs): stride Kp
    _config_ld(plan, Kp, "A")
    for i in range(Mt):
        for k in range(Kt):
            off = (i * DIM * Kp + k * DIM)
            spad = A_sp0 + (i * Kt + k) * DIM
            plan.emit(F_MVIN, ("addr", a_arg, off), _rs2_mvmem(DIM, DIM, spad), "mvin A")

    # compute (output-stationary, accumulate over K in the array)
    cbits = ACC_BIT | (FULL_BIT if full_C else 0)
    for i in range(Mt):
        for j in range(Nt):
            c_off = (i * Nt + j) * DIM
            c_acc = cbits | c_off
            for k in range(Kt):
                out = c_acc if k == Kt - 1 else GARBAGE
                a_sp = A_sp0 + (i * Kt + k) * DIM
                b_sp = B_sp0 + (k * Nt + j) * DIM
                # preload(BD=GARBAGE, C=out)
                plan.emit(F_PRELOAD,
                          (DIM << 48) | (DIM << 32) | GARBAGE,
                          (DIM << 48) | (DIM << 32) | (out & 0xFFFFFFFF), "preload")
                f7 = F_COMPUTE_PRELOADED if k == 0 else F_COMPUTE_ACCUMULATE
                plan.emit(f7,
                          (DIM << 48) | (DIM << 32) | a_sp,
                          (DIM << 48) | (DIM << 32) | b_sp, "compute")

    # mvout C
    for i in range(Mt):
        for j in range(Nt):
            off = (i * DIM * Np + j * DIM) * sizeof_C
            c_acc = cbits | ((i * Nt + j) * DIM)
            plan.emit(F_MVOUT, ("addr", o_arg, off),
                      _rs2_mvmem(DIM, DIM, c_acc), "mvout C")


def _movement_tiles(plan, src_name, dst_name, M, N, dtype):
    """Pure data movement: mvin tiles to scratchpad, mvout back. No compute."""
    Mp, Np = _ceil16(M), _ceil16(N)
    Mt, Nt = Mp // DIM, Np // DIM
    sz = 4 if dtype == "i32" else 1
    s_arg = plan.arg_index[src_name]
    o_arg = plan.arg_index[dst_name]

    _config_ld(plan, Np * sz, "mv")
    _config_st(plan, Np * sz, NO_ACTIVATION, 1.0)
    for i in range(Mt):
        for j in range(Nt):
            off = (i * DIM * Np + j * DIM) * sz
            spad = (i * Nt + j) * DIM
            plan.emit(F_MVIN, ("addr", s_arg, off), _rs2_mvmem(DIM, DIM, spad), "mvin")
    for i in range(Mt):
        for j in range(Nt):
            off = (i * DIM * Np + j * DIM) * sz
            spad = (i * Nt + j) * DIM
            plan.emit(F_MVOUT, ("addr", o_arg, off), _rs2_mvmem(DIM, DIM, spad), "mvout")


def plan_kernel(prog: IR.Program) -> KernelPlan:
    plan = KernelPlan()

    # ---- argument order: [weight] ++ [matmul lhs] ++ [commit outputs] ----
    weight_name = None
    for op in prog.ops:
        if isinstance(op, IR.Pack):
            weight_name = op.src
            break
    if weight_name is not None:
        plan.add_arg(weight_name)
    for op in prog.ops:
        if isinstance(op, IR.Matmul):
            plan.add_arg(op.lhs)
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Conv2d):
            plan.add_arg(op.ifm)
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Movement):
            plan.add_arg(op.src)
    for op in prog.ops:
        if isinstance(op, IR.Commit):
            plan.add_arg(op.dst)
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Conv2d):
            plan.add_arg(op.dst)
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Movement):
            plan.add_arg(op.dst)

    # ---- instruction stream ----
    plan.emit(F_FLUSH, 0, 0, "flush")
    _config_ex(plan)

    # index commits by their accumulator source
    commit_by_acc = {c.src: c for c in prog.ops if isinstance(c, IR.Commit)}

    for op in prog.ops:
        if isinstance(op, IR.Matmul):
            commit = commit_by_acc.get(op.dst)
            M, N = P.matmul_out_shape(prog, op)
            K = prog.tensors[op.lhs].shape[1]
            _matmul_tiles(plan, weight_name, op.lhs, commit.dst, M, K, N,

"""Lower the program to ``llvm.func @gemmini_kernel`` of RoCC ``.insn r 0x7b`` ops.

We perform genuine instruction selection: each high-level op (matmul, commit, movement)
is tiled to a 16x16 weight/output-stationary micro-sequence of real Gemmini RoCC
instructions (CONFIG_EX/LD/ST, MVIN, PRELOAD, COMPUTE_PRELOADED/ACCUMULATE, MVOUT),
mirroring the ``sp_tiled_matmul`` reference in the ISA header. The instruction encodings
(funct7 + rs1/rs2 bit layouts) are taken from ``gemmini.h``.

Each Gemmini instruction is emitted as an LLVM inline-asm op using the exact xcustom.h
template for a no-rd CUSTOM_3 instruction:
    .insn r 0x7b, 0x3, <funct7>, x0, $0, $1     (inputs: rs1, rs2 in "r,r")

The runner links this module's @gemmini_kernel against its own harness, which passes
``ptr weight, ptr lhs_0.., ptr out_0..`` (leaf data, edge-padded to a multiple of 16).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import struct
from typing import Any

from . import iface_ir as IR
from . import passes as P

DIM = 16
BANK_NUM = 4
BANK_ROWS = 4096
SPAD_ROWS = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS  # 16384
ADDR_LEN = 32
GARBAGE = 0xFFFFFFFF

# funct7 opcodes
F_CONFIG = 0
F_MVIN = 2
F_MVOUT = 3
F_COMPUTE_PRELOADED = 4
F_COMPUTE_ACCUMULATE = 5
F_PRELOAD = 6
F_FLUSH = 7

CONFIG_EX = 0
CONFIG_LD = 1
CONFIG_ST = 2

NO_ACTIVATION = 0
RELU = 1
DATAFLOW_OS = 0

ACC_BIT = 1 << (ADDR_LEN - 1)        # bit31: accumulator region
ACCUMULATE_BIT = 1 << (ADDR_LEN - 2)  # bit30: accumulate (vs overwrite)
FULL_BIT = 1 << (ADDR_LEN - 3)        # bit29: full-width (i32) readout


def _f32_bits(x: float) -> int:
    return struct.unpack("<I", struct.pack("<f", x))[0]


IDENT_BITS = _f32_bits(1.0)


def _ceil16(n: int) -> int:
    return ((n + DIM - 1) // DIM) * DIM


class _Instr:
    __slots__ = ("f7", "rs1", "rs2", "comment")

    def __init__(self, f7, rs1, rs2, comment=""):
        self.f7 = f7
        self.rs1 = rs1   # int OR ("addr", arg_index, byte_offset)
        self.rs2 = rs2   # int OR ("addr", ...)
        self.comment = comment


def _rs2_mvmem(rows, cols, spad):
    return (rows << (ADDR_LEN + 16)) | (cols << ADDR_LEN) | (spad & 0xFFFFFFFF)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- planning


class KernelPlan:
    def __init__(self):
        self.args: list[str] = []          # arg name order
        self.arg_index: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.instrs: list[_Instr] = []

    def add_arg(self, name):
        if name not in self.arg_index:
            self.arg_index[name] = len(self.args)
            self.args.append(name)

    def emit(self, f7, rs1, rs2, comment=""):
        self.instrs.append(_Instr(f7, rs1, rs2, comment))


def _config_ex(plan):
    rs1 = (IDENT_BITS << 32) | (1 << 16) | (DATAFLOW_OS << 2) | CONFIG_EX
    rs2 = (1 << 48)  # C_stride=1, in_shift=0
    plan.emit(F_CONFIG, rs1, rs2, "config_ex OS")


def _config_ld(plan, stride_bytes, comment=""):
    rs1 = (IDENT_BITS << 32) | (DIM << 16) | (1 << 8) | CONFIG_LD
    plan.emit(F_CONFIG, rs1, stride_bytes, "config_ld " + comment)


def _config_st(plan, stride_bytes, acc_act, acc_scale):
    rs1 = (acc_act << 2) | CONFIG_ST
    rs2 = (_f32_bits(acc_scale) << 32) | (stride_bytes & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    plan.emit(F_CONFIG, rs1, rs2, "config_st")


def _matmul_tiles(plan, weight_name, lhs_name, out_name, M, K, N,
                  epilogue, output_dtype, acc_scale):
    """Emit the tiled OS matmul + epilogue readout for one matmul/commit pair."""
    Mp, Kp, Np = _ceil16(M), _ceil16(K), _ceil16(N)
    Mt, Kt, Nt = Mp // DIM, Kp // DIM, Np // DIM

    full_C = 1 if output_dtype == "i32" else 0
    sizeof_C = 4 if output_dtype == "i32" else 1
    acc_act = RELU if "relu" in epilogue else NO_ACTIVATION
    scale = float(acc_scale) if (acc_scale is not None and "acc_scale" in epilogue) else 1.0

    w_arg = plan.arg_index[weight_name]
    a_arg = plan.arg_index[lhs_name]
    o_arg = plan.arg_index[out_name]

    A_sp0 = 0
    B_sp0 = SPAD_ROWS - Kt * Nt * DIM

    _config_st(plan, Np * sizeof_C, acc_act, scale)

    # mvin B (weight, the RHS): stride Np
    _config_ld(plan, Np, "B")
    for j in range(Nt):
        for k in range(Kt):
            off = (k * DIM * Np + j * DIM)  # i8 bytes
            spad = B_sp0 + (k * Nt + j) * DIM
            plan.emit(F_MVIN, ("addr", w_arg, off), _rs2_mvmem(DIM, DIM, spad), "mvin B")

    # mvin A (lhs): stride Kp
    _config_ld(plan, Kp, "A")
    for i in range(Mt):
        for k in range(Kt):
            off = (i * DIM * Kp + k * DIM)
            spad = A_sp0 + (i * Kt + k) * DIM
            plan.emit(F_MVIN, ("addr", a_arg, off), _rs2_mvmem(DIM, DIM, spad), "mvin A")

    # compute (output-stationary, accumulate over K in the array)
    cbits = ACC_BIT | (FULL_BIT if full_C else 0)
    for i in range(Mt):
        for j in range(Nt):
            c_off = (i * Nt + j) * DIM
            c_acc = cbits | c_off
            for k in range(Kt):
                out = c_acc if k == Kt - 1 else GARBAGE
                a_sp = A_sp0 + (i * Kt + k) * DIM
                b_sp = B_sp0 + (k * Nt + j) * DIM
                # preload(BD=GARBAGE, C=out)
                plan.emit(F_PRELOAD,
                          (DIM << 48) | (DIM << 32) | GARBAGE,
                          (DIM << 48) | (DIM << 32) | (out & 0xFFFFFFFF), "preload")
                f7 = F_COMPUTE_PRELOADED if k == 0 else F_COMPUTE_ACCUMULATE
                plan.emit(f7,
                          (DIM << 48) | (DIM << 32) | a_sp,
                          (DIM << 48) | (DIM << 32) | b_sp, "compute")

    # mvout C
    for i in range(Mt):
        for j in range(Nt):
            off = (i * DIM * Np + j * DIM) * sizeof_C
            c_acc = cbits | ((i * Nt + j) * DIM)
            plan.emit(F_MVOUT, ("addr", o_arg, off),
                      _rs2_mvmem(DIM, DIM, c_acc), "mvout C")


def _movement_tiles(plan, src_name, dst_name, M, N, dtype):
    """Pure data movement: mvin tiles to scratchpad, mvout back. No compute."""
    Mp, Np = _ceil16(M), _ceil16(N)
    Mt, Nt = Mp // DIM, Np // DIM
    sz = 4 if dtype == "i32" else 1
    s_arg = plan.arg_index[src_name]
    o_arg = plan.arg_index[dst_name]

    _config_ld(plan, Np * sz, "mv")
    _config_st(plan, Np * sz, NO_ACTIVATION, 1.0)
    for i in range(Mt):
        for j in range(Nt):
            off = (i * DIM * Np + j * DIM) * sz
            spad = (i * Nt + j) * DIM
            plan.emit(F_MVIN, ("addr", s_arg, off), _rs2_mvmem(DIM, DIM, spad), "mvin")
    for i in range(Mt):
        for j in range(Nt):
            off = (i * DIM * Np + j * DIM) * sz
            spad = (i * Nt + j) * DIM
            plan.emit(F_MVOUT, ("addr", o_arg, off), _rs2_mvmem(DIM, DIM, spad), "mvout")


def plan_kernel(prog: IR.Program) -> KernelPlan:
    plan = KernelPlan()

    # ---- argument order: [weight] ++ [matmul lhs] ++ [commit outputs] ----
    weight_name = None
    for op in prog.ops:
        if isinstance(op, IR.Pack):
            weight_name = op.src
            break
    if weight_name is not None:
        plan.add_arg(weight_name)
    for op in prog.ops:
        if isinstance(op, IR.Matmul):
            plan.add_arg(op.lhs)
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Conv2d):
            plan.add_arg(op.ifm)
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Movement):
            plan.add_arg(op.src)
    for op in prog.ops:
        if isinstance(op, IR.Commit):
            plan.add_arg(op.dst)
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Conv2d):
            plan.add_arg(op.dst)
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Movement):
            plan.add_arg(op.dst)

    # ---- instruction stream ----
    plan.emit(F_FLUSH, 0, 0, "flush")
    _config_ex(plan)

    # index commits by their accumulator source
    commit_by_acc = {c.src: c for c in prog.ops if isinstance(c, IR.Commit)}

    for op in prog.ops:
        if isinstance(op, IR.Matmul):
            commit = commit_by_acc.get(op.dst)
            M, N = P.matmul_out_shape(prog, op)
            K = prog.tensors[op.lhs].shape[1]
            _matmul_tiles(plan, weight_name, op.lhs, commit.dst, M, K, N,
                          commit.epilogue, commit.output_dtype, commit.acc_scale)
        elif isinstance(op, IR.Movement):
            t = prog.tensors[op.src]
            M, N = (t.shape + [1])[:2] if len(t.shape) >= 2 else (t.shape[0], 1)
            _movement_tiles(plan, op.src, op.dst, t.shape[0], t.shape[1], t.dtype)

    plan.instrs.append(_Instr("fence", 0, 0, "fence"))
    return plan


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- emit MLIR


def _const(lines, ctr, val):
    n = ctr[0]; ctr[0] += 1
    lines.append(f"    %{n} = llvm.mlir.constant({val} : i64) : i64")
    return f"%{n}"

    if isinstance(operand, int):

    # ("addr", arg_index, offset)
    _, arg_index, off = operand

    lines.append(f"    %{p} = llvm.ptrtoint %arg{arg_index} : !llvm.ptr to i64")
    if off == 0:
        return f"%{p}"
    c = _const(lines, ctr, off)
    a = ctr[0]; ctr[0] += 1
    lines.append(f"    %{a} = llvm.add %{p}, {c} : i64")
    return f"%{a}"


def emit_llvm(prog: IR.Program) -> str:
    plan = plan_kernel(prog)
    nargs = len(plan.args)
    arg_decls = ", ".join(f"%arg{i}: !llvm.ptr" for i in range(nargs))

    lines: list[str] = []
    lines.append("module {")
    lines.append(f"  llvm.func @gemmini_kernel({arg_decls}) {{")
    ctr = [0]
    for ins in plan.instrs:
        if ins.f7 == "fence":
            lines.append('    llvm.inline_asm has_side_effects "fence", "" : () -> ()')
            continue
        rs1 = _operand_ssa(lines, ctr, ins.rs1)
        rs2 = _operand_ssa(lines, ctr, ins.rs2)
        asm = f".insn r 0x7b, 0x3, {ins.f7}, x0, $0, $1"
        lines.append(
            f'    llvm.inline_asm has_side_effects "{asm}", "r,r" {rs1}, {rs2} '
            f': (i64, i64) -> ()    // {ins.comment}')
    lines.append("    llvm.return")
    lines.append("  }")
    lines.append("}")
